_comment: Post-ingest data-quality gate (item 5). Structural failures (missing file, zero rows, missing required columns) BLOCK the pipeline; staleness and null-fraction WARN. Declares the files the pricer + risk actually consume, split into (1) PV pricing feeds — the inputs behind trade valuations — and (2) risk/VaR factor-history feeds, plus (3) the integrity-gated SEC reference feed edgar_bond_filings — not a pricing input, but policed here so a degenerate/empty EDGAR download (e.g. every request 403'd) is caught post-ingest as well as at the downloader floor (harness-audit F1). NOTE: edgar_xbrl_facts was deprecated in favour of ARag facts_lookup (harness-audit F2) and is no longer refreshed, so it is de-listed here. A market-data feed NOT listed here is 'ungated' in the catalog: no DQ rule runs on it because no path reads it (reference, redundant, or roadmap feeds). 'ungated' therefore means 'not policed', NOT 'not usable'. Tune max_staleness_days to the EOD SLA.

options/vol_indices/VXN_History.csv._comment: P0 de-alias: EQVOL_QQQ now reads VXN (Nasdaq-100 vol) instead of proxying QQQ to VIX. The other P0 vol indices (RVX/VXD/VXTLT/VXEEM/DSPX/COR1M/COR3M) stay ungated until their consuming phase (P5) reads them -- per this gate's convention that an unlisted feed is simply not-yet-read.

options/signals/option_signals.csv._comment: P1/B1+B2: derived option-implied signals (per-name ATM IV, term slope, 25d skew, VRP, positioning, expected move + RND tail probabilities). A DERIVATION (signals_runner), not a download. High null tolerance: signal columns are null by design for names with a thin chain or no spot history (e.g. ORCL/AMZN have no prices_daily -> null VRP). Only snapshot_date/underlying/atm_iv_30d are structurally required.

options/signals/rnd_curves.csv._comment: P1/B2: risk-neutral density curves (Breeden-Litzenberger) per (underlying, snapshot, target expiry) -- long format, one row per grid strike. Single long CSV, not many small per-name files, so it stays cheap to list on S3 (dual-mode trap 3). The signals_runner clips pdf>=0 and renormalizes to integrate to 1, so nulls should be near-zero.

options/signals/credit_implied.csv._comment: P1/B3: option-implied credit spread (CreditGrades primary + Merton distance-to-default) per (issuer, snapshot), with a CDS cross-check. An INDICATOR, never a pricing input. cds_reference_bp/basis_bp are null for issuers without a single-name CDS reference, hence the 0.5 null tolerance.

factors/ff_factors.csv._comment: P2/F4: Ken French daily style factors (FF5 + Momentum). scenariogen reads the mom column as the style:MOM covariance driver. High null tolerance: the FF5 columns start 1963 while mom goes back to 1926, so early rows have mom but null FF5. Staleness 45d: French refreshes ~monthly, so the series lags the daily market feeds by weeks by design.

rates/fred_real_rates.csv._comment: P5/F6: FRED TIPS real 10Y (DFII10) + breakeven (T10YIE) driving the scenariogen real:/be: covariance drivers (nominal->real/breakeven split, FINDING 6). Driver-only, never a pricing input. Kept in a separate file from fred_rates.csv so it stays out of the pricing snapshot.

rates/nyfed_acm_term_premium.csv._comment: P5/F6: NY Fed ACM 10Y term premium driving the scenariogen tp:ACMTP10 covariance driver (grounds the rate_capital term-premium narrative). Binary .xls parsed via BytesIO (trap 2). Driver-only.

news/sec_events.csv._comment: P3/A1: SEC 8-K allowlisted item-code event stream (structured metadata, no NLP). scenariogen reads it as a per-name news multiplier on the ARag idiosyncratic leg. Staleness 120d: 8-Ks are episodic (only filed on a material event), so a quiet window is normal, not a defect.

news/gdelt_salience.csv._comment: P3/A2: GDELT article-volume/tone salience with z-scores (Tier-2 intensity). Graceful (GDELT throttles), so high null tolerance and it may be absent — news then runs on the 8-K spine alone.

stress/gpr_daily.csv._comment: P7/F8: Caldara-Iacoviello daily GLOBAL geopolitical-risk index. scenariogen reads it as the severity multiplier + trigger for geopolitically-tagged scenarios (mode-(ii)).

stress/gpr_country.csv._comment: P7/F8: monthly GPR country sub-indices (GPRC_TWN/GPRC_CHN) — the Taiwan/China calibration for taiwan_geopolitical. Monthly, so staleness 45d.

stress/epu_daily.csv._comment: P7/F8: Baker-Bloom-Davis daily US economic-policy-uncertainty index (context alongside GPR).

stress/fred_throughput.csv._comment: P7/F9: FRED semiconductor industrial production (IPG3344S). scenariogen reads it (with EIA power demand) as the AI-capex throughput severity multiplier on ai_bust. Monthly + ~2mo FRED release lag, so staleness 75d.

crowding/short_interest.csv._comment: P7/F5: FINRA consolidated short interest (days-to-cover per name). scenariogen reads it as a per-name crowding multiplier on the ARag idiosyncratic leg (+ the #6 SMH crowded-short squeeze flag). Twice-monthly, so staleness 30d. CFTC COT dropped (unreachable).
